summary.text: Venise Karris is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 10 who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A retired journeyman wireman with IBEW Local 357, she said in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey that a living wage is the backbone of her campaign.

paragraphs.text: Karris was born in Chicago, Illinois, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Illinois in 1980.
Her career experience includes working as a research scientist and journeyman wireman.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she moved to Las Vegas in 1995 with her two daughters, entered the Electrical JATC in 1996, and worked 27 years as a journeyman wireman before retiring as a member of IBEW Local 357.
She also said she served on the local's executive board and as a steward for nearly seven years.
Karris assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Sabra Newby, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Government Affairs, Growth and Infrastructure, and Natural Resources committees.
In the same survey she named a living wage, including health benefits and retirement, and enshrining reproductive health care in the Nevada Constitution among her key messages.
